semiconductor_relevance: High — mtu India Private Limited provides critical power infrastructure solutions specifically designed for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: mtu India Private Limited offers the mtu Kinetic PowerPack, a battery-free Diesel Rotary UPS (DRUPS) that ensures continuous, high-quality power for semiconductor fabrication and advanced electronics manufacturing. This solution safeguards manufacturing processes from power disturbances, thereby enhancing process stability and product yield.
